reason.pt-BR: O que aconteceu no dia da erupção que formou esses moldes.
reason.en: What happened on the day of the eruption that created these casts.

reason.pt-BR: Além das vítimas, Pompeia guardou a voz dos moradores nas paredes.
reason.en: Besides its victims, Pompeii kept its people’s voices on the walls.

reason.pt-BR: Outra imagem do passado que veio mais das suposições modernas do que das provas.
reason.en: Another picture of the past that owed more to modern assumptions than to evidence.
